note: One entry per node type in the Phase 1 deterministic graph. 'source_field' names the metadata field read from data/processed/documents/*.json. 'key_field' is what makes the node unique; hub nodes are deduplicated on it so a Department appears once, not once per document. Phase 2 adds five content-derived node types extracted from document text with a curated pattern dictionary; their key is the canonical concept name.

Document.description: A single canonical unstructured document from the ingestion pipeline. Also used for stub nodes created from unresolved related_ids, which carry resolved=false.

properties.name: document_id
properties.description: Stable identifier, e.g. FAQ_012.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Human-readable document title. Empty on stubs.

properties.name: document_type
properties.description: Editorial form, duplicated here as a property for convenient filtering.

properties.name: version
properties.description: Document version string as written in metadata.

properties.name: last_updated
properties.description: ISO date string of last update.

properties.name: file_type
properties.description: Source file format: markdown, json, docx.

properties.name: source_authority
properties.description: Publishing authority, duplicated here as a property.

properties.name: resolved
properties.description: true when the document exists among the 148 canonical files; false for a stub created from a dangling related_id.

properties.name: stub
properties.description: Inverse of resolved. Present so stubs are trivially filterable in graphml.

DocumentType.description: The editorial form of a document. Hub node shared by every document of that form.
DocumentType.expected_instances: 13 distinct values in the current corpus

properties.name: name
properties.description: Verbatim document_type value, e.g. FAQ, SOP, RCA.

Category.description: A NovaTel business category code declared in document metadata. The human-readable name comes from category_catalog in ontology_schema.json, not from the structured branch taxonomy.

properties.name: code
properties.description: Category code exactly as stored, e.g. C08 or GENERAL.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Display name looked up in category_catalog.

properties.name: name_source
properties.description: document when a name string appeared in the corpus, inferred when the name was assigned by the ontology author, unmapped for a code absent from the catalog.

Department.description: The internal business unit that owns the document. Hub node.
Department.expected_instances: 13 distinct values in the current corpus

properties.name: name
properties.description: Verbatim department value, e.g. Network, Billing.

CustomerScope.description: The customer segment a document applies to. Hub node.
CustomerScope.expected_instances: 4 distinct values: all, prepaid, postpaid, enterprise

properties.name: name
properties.description: Verbatim customer_scope value.

Tag.description: A free-form keyword attached to a document. Hub node shared by every document carrying that exact tag string.
Tag.expected_instances: 68 distinct tag strings in the current corpus

properties.name: name
properties.description: Tag string used verbatim. No case folding, stemming or normalisation is applied in Phase 1.

SourceAuthority.description: The authority that published or vouches for the document. Hub node.
SourceAuthority.expected_instances: 1 distinct value in the current corpus (Internal Knowledge Base)

properties.name: name
properties.description: Verbatim source_authority value.
